name: newer-value-supersedes
description: A newer value replaces an older one. The scripted reply also names an id that was never given.

fact.statement: Ojas decided to cap the client at 500 requests per minute to leave headroom under the vendor's limit.

neighbours.statement: The vendor API client is capped at 300 requests per minute.
The vendor API allows 600 requests per minute per API key.
Vendor webhooks are verified with an HMAC signature.
